descriptions.g2b_remove_record_801f9c60: Searches external contiguous24B records for matching leading ID and16B GUID, comparing GUID words in first/fourth/second/third order. For first match, shifts trailing records down one via complete native24B record copies, decrements end pointer and returns zero; returns80004005 if absent. No local external object construction, no data ownership, names inferred. Pointer-range ownership is external and no fixed array extent is declared.
